record.field: Your instance {{ object.name }} will be suspended soon

div.p: Your subscription for {{ object.name }} ({{ object.plan_id.name }}) has expired.
If payment is not received within 7 days, your instance will be suspended. Your data will remain intact, but the instance will be stopped.
Please update your payment method to avoid interruption.

record.field: Your instance {{ object.name }} has been suspended

div.p: Your instance {{ object.name }} has been suspended due to non-payment.
Your data is still preserved. If payment is not received within 23 more days, the instance will be permanently destroyed.
Please update your payment to reactivate your instance.

record.field: URGENT: Your instance {{ object.name }} will be destroyed in 7 days

div.p: URGENT: Your instance {{ object.name }} will be permanently destroyed in 7 days if payment is not received.
After destruction, all data will be lost and cannot be recovered.
Please update your payment immediately to keep your instance.
